entries.source: And now for a grave
entries.target: 接下来，是一座坟墓

entries.source: The mad sun brought forth all its power through the portal, turning the High Peak into a giant searing needle!
entries.target: 疯狂的太阳通过传送门释放出全部力量，将巅峰化为一根灼热的巨针！

entries.source: You have prevented the portal to the Void from opening and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
entries.target: 你阻止了虚空传送门的开启，从而阻止了造物主毁灭世界。

entries.source: You have entered the Infinite Dungeon. There is no going back now.
entries.target: 你进入了无尽地下城。你已不能再走回头路了。

entries.source: Keepsake
entries.target: 往昔信物

entries.source: You have begun to look for a way to overcome the curse that afflicts you.
entries.target: 你开始寻求方法以驱除一直困扰着你的诅咒。

entries.source: You have found a small iron acorn which you keep as a reminder of your past.
entries.target: 你找到了一个小小的铁质橡果，将它保留下来，作为对过去的提醒。

entries.source: You have destroyed the merchant caravan that you once considered family.
entries.target: 你摧毁了那个你曾经视作家人的商队。

entries.source: Kyless, the one who brought the curse, is dead by your hand.
entries.target: 凯勒斯，那个曾经为你带来诅咒的人，死在了你的手上。

entries.source: Berethh is dead, may he rest in peace.
entries.target: 贝里斯已死，但愿他能安息。

entries.source: Your curse has changed the iron acorn which now serves as a cruel reminder of your past and present.
entries.target: 你的诅咒改变了铁橡果，如今它成了一件残酷的信物，令你回想起自己的过去与现在。

entries.source: You have found a small iron acorn which you keep as a reminder of your past
entries.target: 你找到了一个小小的铁质橡果，将它保留下来，作为对过去的提醒。

entries.source: Your curse has defiled the iron acorn which now serves as a reminder of your vile nature.
entries.target: 你的诅咒玷污了铁橡果，它成了提醒你自身卑劣本性的信物。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You need to find Berethh, the last person who may be able to help you.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你得找到贝里斯，也许他是最后一个可以帮助你的人。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Seek out Kyless' cave in the northern part of the meadow and end him. Perhaps the curse will end with him.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#找出位于草原北部的凯勒斯的洞穴，然后杀掉他，他的死也许会解除这个诅咒。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Discover the meaning of the acorn and the dream.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#搞清楚铁橡果与这个梦境的含义。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You may have to revist your past to unlock some secret buried there.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你可能需要重访过去，以解开埋藏在那里的秘密。

entries.source: #VIOLET#The time has come to learn the true nature of your curse.
entries.target: #VIOLET#是时候搞清楚你诅咒的本质了。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You find yourself in a dream.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你发现你在一个梦境里。

entries.source: #VIOLET#Your hate surges. You refuse to succumb to death!
entries.target: #VIOLET#你的仇恨涌动，你拒绝向死亡屈服！

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have discovered a small iron acorn, a link to your past.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你发现了一个小铁橡果，它和你的过去有关。

entries.source: #VIOLET#The merchant caravan from the past has appeared in your dream.
entries.target: #VIOLET#很久以前商队的往事出现在你的梦里。

entries.source: Last of the Caravan
entries.target: 商队的最后一人

entries.source: secret path to the cave
entries.target: 通向山洞的秘密通道

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have begun your hunt for Kyless!
entries.target: #VIOLET#你开始追杀凯勒斯！

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have a marker to the entrance of Kyless' cave!
entries.target: #VIOLET#你获得了通往凯勒斯洞穴入口的标记！

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have found the entrance to Kyless' cave!
entries.target: #VIOLET#你找到了通往凯勒斯洞穴的入口！

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have found the entrance to a vault!
entries.target: #VIOLET#你找到了通往一处宝库的入口！

entries.source: #VIOLET#The shadows have noticed you!
entries.target: #VIOLET#阴影注意到了你！

entries.source: A Second Vault
entries.target: 另一处宝库

entries.source: You recognize this door as the entrance to a second vault. There are some scuffling noises and heavy breathing coming from the other side of the door.
entries.target: 你认出来这扇门是通向另一处宝库的门户。你可以听到门的另一边有拖曳的脚步声和沉重的呼吸声。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have found Kyless. You must destroy him.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你找到了凯勒斯，你必须杀死他。

entries.source: Death of Kyless
entries.target: 凯勒斯之死

entries.source: #VIOLET#Kyless is dead.
entries.target: #VIOLET#凯勒斯死了。

entries.source: Berethh
entries.target: 贝里斯

entries.source: #VIOLET#Berethh lies dead.
entries.target: #VIOLET#贝里斯死了。

entries.source: The Sect of Kryl-Feijan
entries.target: 克里尔·费扬教派

entries.source: You discovered a sect worshipping a demon named Kryl-Feijan in a crypt.
entries.target: 你在一个地宫中发现了一个教派，他们崇拜一个名叫克里尔·费扬的恶魔。

entries.source: They were trying to bring it back into the world using a human sacrifice.
entries.target: 他们试图用献祭活人来召唤恶魔到这个世界上。

entries.source: You defeated the acolytes and saved the woman. She told you she is the daughter of a rich merchant of Last Hope.
entries.target: 你打败了那些侍僧并救下了这个女人。她告诉你，她是最后的希望城中一位富商的女儿。

entries.source: You failed to protect her when escorting her out of the crypt.
entries.target: 你没能在护送她离开这个地宫时保护好她。

entries.source: You failed to defeat the acolytes in time - the woman got torn apart by the demon growing inside her.
entries.target: 你没能及时杀死那些侍僧，那个女人被在她体内成长的恶魔撕成了碎片。

entries.source: From Death, Life
entries.target: 起死回生

entries.source: The affairs of this mortal world are trifling compared to your true goal: To conquer death.
entries.target: 凡人世界的那些琐事，与你的终极目标——超越死亡——相比，都是微不足道的。

entries.source: Your studies have uncovered much surrounding this subject, but now you must prepare for your glorious rebirth.
entries.target: 你关于这个主题的研究已经令你发现了很多东西，现在，你必须准备你辉煌的重生仪式。

entries.source: You will need:
entries.target: 你需要：

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You are experienced enough.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你有足够的经验。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* The ceremony will require that you are worthy, experienced, and possessed of a certain amount of power (level 25, Magic over 50, Willpower over 25 and one prodigy point available).#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 仪式要求你具备资格、经验丰富，并拥有足够的力量（达到 25 级、魔力超过 50、意志超过 25，且有 1 点可用的觉醒点）。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have 'extracted' the heart of one of your fellow necromancers.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经“取出”了一位死灵法师同类的心脏。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* The beating heart of a powerful necromancer.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 一颗强大死灵法师跳动的心脏。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Yiilkgur the Sher'tul Fortress is a suitable location.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 夏·图尔堡垒伊克格是个合适的地方。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Yiilkgur has enough energy.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 伊克格有足够的能量。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You are now on the path of lichdom.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经做好了成为巫妖的准备。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* Use the control orb of Yiilkgur to begin the ceremony.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 使用伊克格的控制水晶球来开启仪式。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* Your lair must amass enough energy to use in your rebirth (40 energy).#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你的堡垒中必须积累足够的能量才能开启重生仪式。（40 能量）#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* The ceremony will require a suitable location, secluded and given to the channelling of energy#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 仪式必须在一个合适的地方进行，要足够隐蔽，又便于引导能量。#WHITE#

entries.source: #CRIMSON#* You have ascended to Lichdom!#WHITE#
entries.target: #CRIMSON#* 你完成了巫妖转生！#WHITE#

entries.source: Lichform
entries.target: 巫妖转生

entries.source: The secrets of death lay open to you! You are to become a Lich upon your next death!
entries.target: 死亡的秘密已经朝你打开了！你下一次死亡就会转生为巫妖！

entries.source: Storming the city
entries.target: 风暴袭城

entries.source: As you approached Derth you saw a huge dark cloud over the small town.
entries.target: 当你接近德斯镇时，你看到一大片漆黑的乌云笼罩在小镇上方。

entries.source: When you entered you were greeted by an army of air elementals slaughtering the population.
entries.target: 当你进入小镇时，迎面所见是一群正在屠杀居民的空气元素。

entries.source: * You have dispatched the elementals but the cloud lingers still. You must find a powerful ally to remove it. There are rumours of a secret town in the mountains, to the southwest. You could also check out the Ziguranth group that is supposed to fight magic.
entries.target: * 你已经消灭了那些元素生物，但是天上乌云并未就此散去。你必须找到一位强大的盟友才能驱散它。传说中，在西南方的山脉之中有一个神秘的小镇，你也能顺便调查一下伊格兰斯——据称这是一个与魔法为敌的组织。

entries.source: * You have learned the real threat comes from a rogue Archmage, a Tempest named Urkis. The mages of Angolwen are ready to teleport you there.
entries.target: * 你得知真正的威胁来自于一个叛逃的元素法师，名字叫厄奇斯，精通风暴法术，安格利文的法师已经准备好把你传送到那里去了。

entries.source: * You have learned the real threat comes from a rogue Archmage, a Tempest. You have been shown a secret entrance to his stronghold.
entries.target: * 你得知真正的威胁来自于一位叛逃的元素法师，也就是一位风暴法师。有人为你指出了通往他秘密据点的一条隐秘通道。

entries.source: * You have slain Urkis.  Return to Angolwen or Zigur for a reward.
entries.target: * 你干掉了厄奇斯。现在返回安格利文或者伊格领取奖励吧。

entries.source: * Urkis has been dealt with. Permanently.
entries.target: * 厄奇斯被永远解决掉了。

entries.source: Scared Halfling
entries.target: 惊恐的半身人

entries.source: Danger...
entries.target: 小心……

entries.source:
You step out on unfamiliar grounds. You are nearly on top of one of the highest peaks you can see.
The storm is raging above your head.
entries.target:
你进入了一个不熟悉的地方。你几乎站在了你能看到的最高峰位置。
风暴在你的头顶肆虐。

entries.source:
As you arrive in Derth you notice a huge dark cloud hovering over the town.
You hear screams coming from the town square.
entries.target:
当你到达德斯镇时你注意到小镇上空有一大团黑压压的乌云。
你听到小镇广场上传来的尖叫声。

entries.source: Clear sky
entries.target: 晴朗的天空

entries.source:
It seems the Ziguranth have kept their word.
Derth is free of the storm cloud.
entries.target:
似乎伊格兰斯们遵守了他们的诺言。
德斯镇的风暴威胁解除了。

entries.source:
It seems the mages have kept their word.
Derth is free of the storm cloud.
entries.target:
似乎法师们遵守了他们的诺言。
德斯镇的风暴威胁解除了。

entries.source: Trapped!
entries.target: 陷阱！

entries.source: You heard a plea for help and decided to investigate...
entries.target: 你听到了求救声，决定去调查一下……

entries.source: Only to find yourself trapped inside an unknown tunnel complex.
entries.target: 却发现自己被困在一片陌生的地下通道群中。

entries.source: A stairway out appears at your feet. The Lord says: 'And remember, you are MINE. I will call you.'
entries.target: 一道通往外界的楼梯出现在你脚下。刺客领主说道：“记住，你是我的人。我会召唤你的。”

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#The merchant thanks you for saving his life. He gives you 8 gold and asks you to meet him again in Last Hope.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#商人感谢你救了他的命。他给了你8金币，邀请你在最后的希望见他。
